appearance.identity: Stock-brick twin-arch southern clock facade, two barrel train roofs, eastern/western ranges, tapering suburban shed and semicircular western concourse with central funnel.
appearance.master: Original detailed component assembly and source hash retained unchanged.
appearance.browser: New recognizable skyline; closer levels retain source architecture with bounded reduction, shared materials and separate GPU streams.
appearance.exclusions: Precise shopfronts, sign lettering, Roman clock numerals, engineering joints and underground spaces are outside the medium-fi exterior scope.

nativeAxes.front: +Z is the southern clock facade; +X is east; +Y is up
nativeAxes.origin: Approximate combined station and concourse plan centre, at platform approach ground level

sourceFacts.drawings: Arup Journal 2/2012: photographs pp.8–9,11,15; station sections pp.10–11; three tangent-circle construction Fig.3 p.13; Western Range plan and historic section p.27; proposed square p.42.
sourceFacts.dimensionsCaution: The 30.48 m train span and detailed envelope proportions are a scaled section fit in this study, not an independent building survey. The 2012 square image is a proposal, not proof of current site conditions.

geographic.evidence: The inspected aerial picture identifies the western semicircular concourse beside the long train sheds. Standard viewer PMTiles retains a combined building envelope approximately164m across and256m long; source bounds are165.4x250.1m. Retained heading places native+Z at the southern clock facade and the concourse to the west. Working PMTiles datum16.271386566468557m sets approximate floor contact. A bounded inset opening only under the authored covered floor avoids coarse urban terrain through platforms/concourse; surrounding raw PMTiles remain. Member footprints, exact entry thresholds and signed bearing are approximate visualization, not surveys.
geographic.limitations: Approximate combined PMTiles envelope and picture-guided signed orientation; exact member footprints and threshold elevations are not claimed.

Detailed original source assembly/hash/recipe preserved; skyline is separately authored and closer levels use bounded reductions.

The twin roof/clock facade, western concourse/funnel and distinct range/shed volumes carry identity. Clock ticks stand for numerals; facade modules, diagrid pattern, glazing and platforms are interpretations rather than exact restoration inventories.

Shared procedural textures; no duplicated embedded images. Underground spaces, adjacent hotel/trains and exact station furniture/sign lettering are excluded. Reversible inset floor cutout leaves raw surrounding terrain; footprint replacement off; physical-device timing unmeasured.
